title.rendered: Van Dyk Recycling Solutions and SMICON at Waste Expo 2025, Las Vegas, NV

content.rendered: Van Dyk’s partner SMICON demonstrates its depackaging and organics recycling equipment, pointing out the unique features and benefits of SMICON’s machines to waste handling and food processing companies.
